verdict.detail: Discogs lists 3 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

physical: Pressed by CBS Pressing Plant, Aston Clinton

notes.text:
This is the original UK release in a die-cut gatefold cover, shaped like an old television set with a plastic 'screen' window.
Mustard Reprise Records labels, with custom 'Family' logo.
Top-opening cover-shaped lyrics inner sleeve.

Recorded at Olympic, London

℗ 1972

A Reprise Record Distributed By WEA Records Ltd ℗ 1972
© 1972 Reprinted by kind permission United Artists Music

The track numbering runs continuously from 1 to 9.

A Tivstan Co-ordination.
PAK by Shorewood Packaging Co. Ltd., England.
A WEA UK Recording

Runouts are stamped.
